entries.title: Task cards open tall enough to show everything
entries.body: A task card with a long Progress list now grows to show Goal, Activity and Details when it opens, instead of hiding them until you scroll. Its buttons stay put: Drop task at the left edge, and Start, Continue or Show the card at the right. The sentence beside the buttons that repeated the task's status is gone.

picture.alt: A task card waiting on you, shown whole: its Progress list, the model readout, Drop task at the left edge and Show the card at the right
